title: Convergence analysis of a full discretization of operator-valued differential Riccati equations
summary: In recent previous work [E. Hansen, T. Stillfjord and T. Åberg, SIAM J. Numer. Anal., to appear], we analyzed the convergence of operator splitting methods applied to operator-valued differential Riccati equations (DRE). In this paper, we extend these results by analyzing the convergence of a full discretization based on finite elements in space and Lie splitting in time. As far as we are aware, this is the first such analysis for DRE.
